issues.description: Silent default change from EXTERNAL to FIXED flips turn-ownership semantics with no migration note.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flag this. The default of `turn_detection_mode` flips from EXTERNAL to FIXED, silently changing which actor decides end-of-turn for existing callers who omitted the parameter. No changelog entry, docstring migration note, or opt-in gate accompanies the change. Document loudly or gate behind an explicit opt-in.

issues.description: `_enable_vad` complects multiple concerns and its name mismatches its semantics.
issues.detail: One boolean now governs frame emission, acceptance of external finalize, and a warning branch, with a double-negative `elif not self._enable_vad` that reads as a smuggled state machine. The name suggests 'VAD is enabled' but it means 'this plugin emits VAD frames.' Decompose into two named predicates derived from the mode enum and state the invariant in a comment.

issues.description: VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame handler warns-then-noops or finalizes based on hidden mode state.
issues.detail: When `_enable_vad` is true, the branch logs a warning and does nothing; when false, it finalizes. The frame's meaning shouldn't depend on hidden flag state to decide log-vs-act. Either accept-and-finalize unconditionally, or route the frame at the dispatcher so this method only sees frames it should act on. State the precondition explicitly.

issues.description: `speech_segment_config` is unconditionally overwritten and `split_sentences or False` collapses tri-state.
issues.detail: `params.split_sentences` is declared `bool | None = None` but written as `params.split_sentences or False`, collapsing None and False and stomping any SDK default. The write also discards what the generic keys loop may have set. Decide whether None means 'use library default' or 'disabled' and encode it in the schema rather than papering over at the write site.

issues.description: Commented-out `start_processing_metrics()` call moved but not resolved.
issues.detail: The line `# await self.start_processing_metrics()` was relocated from after the interruption frame to before it. All three reviewers note this is unresolved indecision encoded in source. Either uncomment and own the metrics start at StartOfTurn, or delete the line. Commented code drifting through diffs accumulates as noise.

issues.description: `split_sentences` threaded through a stringly-typed allowlist with no schema-driven mapping.
issues.detail: Adding a parameter requires editing a name in a hard-coded list and trusting `hasattr` to silently drop typos. Express the config mapping as data derived from the InputParams schema so adding a field happens in one place, and typos surface loudly rather than silently no-op. Also note `split_sentences` is both forwarded by the keys loop and overwritten below.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a small diff with outsized semantic consequences. The default flip from EXTERNAL to FIXED silently changes who owns end-of-turn for existing callers and lands with no migration note. `_enable_vad` is the structural smell: one boolean complects frame emission, external-finalize acceptance, and a warning branch, with a double-negative elif that reads as a smuggled state machine. The VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame handler's log-or-finalize behavior depends on hidden mode state rather than the frame's value. Config plumbing for `split_sentences` is stringly-typed, tri-state-collapsing, and double-written, and a commented metrics call drifts through the diff unresolved.
